context.topic: splitting rent after one moved out

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: You said you'd cover half the rent this month and you didn't.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: I moved out on the 3rd, why would I pay for a place I'm not living in?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Because the lease is in both our names until August.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: That's not fair, you're the one who wanted me gone.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: I never said that. I just need us to figure out the money.
